text:
alex: Quick triage: advanced per-tenant telemetry (session-level cost breakdown + token provenance) was asked by two pilot customers. Sales wants it in v1.

mira: Engineering note: that telemetry touches tracing, billing exporter, and SDK work. Estimate 2-3 weeks full effort, adds risk to canary.

devin: Product POV: telemetry is nice-to-have for v1. Its high visibility but not required to get customers running inference. We could ship basic metrics and add advanced telemetry in v1.1.

tara: Ops: supporting pilot customers without advanced telemetry is fine if we provide a short runbook and export hooks.

alex: Proposal: cut advanced telemetry from v1 scope; keep core metrics (latency, errors, tokens) and promise advanced telemetry in v1.1 with clear milestone. That preserves v1 date and reduces QA surface.
mira: +1. Save the 2-3 week work for v1.1. Il outline the v1.1 telemetry RFC next sprint.
devin: Il add a customer-facing note to the pilot onboarding that advanced telemetry is coming in v1.1.
tara: Ops will create a temporary export script for pilots.
alex: Quick reaction check: react with :thumbsup: to cut, :thumbsdown: to keep in v1.
mira: :thumbsup:
devin: :thumbsup:

alex: Consensus to cut. Il update the milestone tracker and notify sales. Thanks.
